test_title: PYST 28: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Choose the correct meaning of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

He became a __teetotaller__ after witnessing the negative effects of alcohol on his friends.

options.text: Someone who does not consume any alcoholic drink
A person who likes to eat and drink
A person who is very conscious of his health
Someone who does not make friends

solution:
The correct answer is: **Someone who does not consume any alcoholic drink.**
